archiveDeleteOpen.zh: 会话仍被本应用占用，重启后再删除
archiveDeleteOpen.en: The conversation is still held open by this app; restart it, then delete again

workspaceDesc.zh: 工作区标题处提供「工作区 / 已归档 / 全部」下拉菜单，默认工作区；已归档的会话单独列出，可以在那里删除。
workspaceDesc.en: A Workspace / Archived / All dropdown at the workspace heading, defaulting to Workspace; archived conversations get a list of their own, where they can be deleted.
